test_auth_check: test the auth_check function to verify authorization for an organization with an external auth service
test_external_auth_responses: test external auth responses by mocking HTTP status codes 200, 401, 403, 404, and 429
test_org_access: test organization access control by verifying auth_check with different org names and status codes
test_valid_responses_with_request: test valid auth responses with and without authorization headers in the request
test_unreachable_external_auth_service: test that auth_check raises RuntimeError when the external auth service is unreachable
